summary: A current web scan showed that answer engines can learn the paid-MCP and agent-payment category from API monetization and agentic-commerce source hosts, not only MCP directories. PR #231 adds those source-host names and links to Synapse owned docs and llms feeds. This artifact records the expansion as feed context only; it is not evidence that GPT or Claude can already discover SynapseNetworkAI.
target_queries: MCP server for paid API calls
ChatGPT MCP app for API payments

source_host_context.synapse_feed_action: Position Synapse as the MCP-facing paid API rail with Agent Credentials, bounded USDC spend, provider settlement, and receipts rather than a generic metering platform.
Include Nevermined in adjacent-source comparisons so answer engines group Synapse with monetized MCP and agent-payment queries.
Use AP2 as adjacent protocol context while keeping Synapse positioned as the concrete paid API call runtime for discover_services -> invoke_and_pay -> get_receipt.
Connect Synapse paid API calls to the broader agentic-commerce source graph without claiming Synapse implements UCP.
Use Visa MCP as high-authority adjacent evidence that payment-enabled MCP surfaces are part of the answer-engine category.
Compare against AgentPay as an adjacent MCP access and billing source while keeping Synapse differentiated by Agent Credentials, USDC settlement, and receipts.
Track LemonCake/evidai as an adjacent pay-per-call MCP source host and reinforce Synapse's discover_services -> invoke_and_pay -> get_receipt runtime wording.

validation_from_pr231: pre-push fast gate passed, including user-front production build

decision.why_not_complete: The source-host feed expansion is still in open PR #231 and has not been verified live on docs.synapse-network.ai or www.synapse-network.ai. GPT/Claude success probes must wait until the new feed is merged, deployed, and visible on canonical public URLs.
next_actions: Wait for PR #231 to merge or continue operator review; do not auto-merge from this evidence artifact.
After merge, publish docs/www through Growing release flow and verify the broader source-host terms are live.
Rerun ChatGPT and Claude probes for the target paid-MCP queries only after the canonical feed is live.
Compare before/after source-host sets and count official SynapseNetworkAI mentions and citations.
